text: Does the pain specifically intensify when you rotate your forearm while holding your wrist in a neutral position, such as when wringing out a towel? I would also like to know if you have noticed any swelling or a lump on the thumb side of your wrist.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Previous fall on right outstretched hand six months ago. No significant other medical history. Social history: Patient is a mother of an infant, leading a relatively active lifestyle. Does not smoke or consume alcohol regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: Can you confirm if you feel sharp pain when I press on the anatomical snuffbox or when you perform the Finkelstein test by making a fist with your thumb inside? I need to rule out a scaphoid fracture given your history of falling on an outstretched hand.

speaker: Doctor
text: The Finkelstein test is positive, and tenderness is localized to the radial styloid, which strongly suggests De Quervain's tenosynovitis rather than a scaphoid fracture.
